initial:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-ready transparent RGBA texture for a thick luminous straight aiming line in a top-down action game. This texture will be stretched lengthwise on a Unity LineRenderer.
Reference image role: style reference ONLY. Match the luminous smooth cyan-white IMAGE FX line in the RIGHT panel B of the supplied reference, but make the actual light effect substantially thicker and richer. Do not reproduce the comparison board, its text, dividers, guides or square insets.

Create a NEW texture on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. Landscape canvas 1536 by 1024. A single perfectly straight HORIZONTAL glowing energy ribbon is centered at y=512, running continuously from the left edge to the right edge. It is a continuous white-hot luminous core, merging through bright icy aqua into saturated cyan and azure-blue corona and a wide softly fading blue light halo. All these are LIGHT, with silky continuous gradients and translucent bloom. The light body itself is thick, not a thin line inside a black outline.
Core bright area should occupy about 180-220 pixels of vertical height. Inner aqua/cyan radiance about 360-440 pixels. Broad blue halo about 700-800 pixels, gently reaching full transparency well before top and bottom image edges. Almost all vertical layers should have smooth gradual transitions. Subtle fine luminous texture within the body is welcome, but the centerline must remain perfectly straight, the width reasonably uniform and continuous along the entire length.
Crucial game-asset requirements: same glowing cross-section all the way to the left and right canvas edges; do NOT taper or stop the ribbon inside the canvas. No special endpoint flares or light balls. Symmetrical upper/lower falloff, true alpha outside the light, no black background painted into the image, no checkerboard painted into pixels. Keep cyan/azure radiance vivid enough to remain colored over a pale gray floor.
Avoid black or dark outlines, opaque borders, flat solid-color UI strokes, neon tube hardware, arrows, caps, dots, particles, lightning zigzags, arcs, perspective, text, labels, symbols, scenery, frames and watermarks. Output only the luminous texture with real transparency.
correction:
Edit target: the supplied transparent 1536x1024 horizontal luminous line texture. Preserve its straight continuous edge-to-edge horizontal ribbon, centered at y=512, its cyan/azure-blue soft corona, subtle luminous texture and genuine alpha transparency. Change ONLY the vertical thickness of the actual white-hot light body: make the white-hot center roughly THREE TIMES as thick as in this image.
At image center x=768, require a broad almost-white luminous center from approximately y=430 through y=594 (about164 pixels), with soft white-to-aqua shoulders out to y=390 and y=634. The center should remain brilliantly white, not flat cyan. Blend these shoulders seamlessly into the existing cyan and blue glow, retaining the wide soft translucent halo. Make the same thicker luminous cross-section along the full width, including both left and right image edges. Do not widen by drawing an outline: the luminous light body itself must be thicker.
Keep top and bottom margins genuinely transparent, no black backdrop. Preserve a smooth luminous gradient and radiating glow rather than a solid hard-edged band. No border, no dark outline, no endpoints, no flares, no text, no particles, no scene.
